title: Gds1 Interacts with NuA4 To Promote H4 Acetylation at Ribosomal Protein Genes.
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Gds1与NuA4互作促进核糖体蛋白基因H4乙酰化，虽涉及蛋白-DNA关联和AlphaFold2结构预测，但核心是表观遗传调控而非TF-DNA结合机制建模，方法上无AI/物理模拟的互作建模。
abstract: In our previously published studies, RNA polymerase II transcription initiation complexes were assembled from yeast nuclear extracts onto immobilized transcription templates and analyzed by quantitative mass spectrometry. In addition to the expected basal factors and coactivators, we discovered that the uncharacterized protein Gds1/YOR355W showed activator-stimulated association with promoter DNA. Gds1 coprecipitated with the histone H4 acetyltransferase NuA4, and its levels often tracked with NuA4 in immobilized-template experiments. GDS1 deletion led to a reduction in H4 acetylation in vivo and caused other phenotypes consistent with a partial loss of NuA4 activity. Genome-wide chromatin immunoprecipitation revealed that the reduction in H4 acetylation was strongest at ribosomal protein gene promoters and other genes with high NuA4 occupancy. Therefore, while Gds1 is not a stoichiometric subunit of NuA4, we propose that it interacts with and modulates NuA4 in specific promoter contexts. Gds1 has no obvious metazoan homolog, but the Alphafold2 algorithm predicts that a section of Gds1 resembles the winged-helix/forkhead domain found in DNA-binding proteins such as the FOX transcription factors and histone H1.
abstract_zh: 在我们先前发表的研究中，RNA聚合酶II转录起始复合物是从酵母核提取物中组装到固定化转录模板上，并通过定量质谱分析。除了预期的 basal factors 和 coactivators，我们发现未表征蛋白 Gds1/YOR355W 表现出激活剂刺激的与启动子DNA的结合。Gds1 与组蛋白H4乙酰转移酶 NuA4 共沉淀，且在固定化模板实验中其水平常与 NuA4 同步。GDS1 缺失导致体内 H4 乙酰化减少，并引起其他与 NuA4 活性部分丧失一致的表型。全基因组染色质免疫沉淀显示，H4 乙酰化减少在核糖体蛋白基因启动子及其他 NuA4 高占据基因处最为显著。因此，尽管 Gds1 并非 NuA4 的化学计量亚基，我们提出它在特定启动子背景下与 NuA4 相互作用并调节其功能。Gds1 没有明显的后生动物同源物，但 Alphafold2 算法预测 Gds1 的一段区域类似于在 DNA 结合蛋白（如 FOX 转录因子和组蛋白 H1）中发现的 winged-helix/forkhead 结构域。
